title: Enterprise AI Gateway Deep Dive: Azure APIM vs. LiteLLM Proxy vs. Kong AI vs. Envoy AI Gateway / Higress Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Generic HTTP L7 Proxy (Nginx/ALB — RPM-Only Rate Limiting, 60s Timeout & Zero Token Accounting)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 128K requests bypass RPM limits; 60s timeout stalls users during regional PTU throttling

tiers.name: Tier 2: Standalone LiteLLM Proxy (100+ Providers, Virtual Keys & Spend Ledger — Python Worker Bottleneck at >2K RPS)
tiers.verdict: Best agility for <=1,000 RPS multi-provider routing & FinOps chargeback, needs L7 proxy front at ultra-high RPS

tiers.name: Tier 3: Managed Enterprise AI Gateway (Azure APIM / Kong AI — Entra ID RBAC, PTU Token Limit & Failover)
tiers.verdict: Gold standard for Azure OpenAI PTU + PAYGO failover & enterprise API governance

tiers.name: Tier 4: Envoy AI Gateway / Higress (K8s Gateway API Inference Extension: KV/LoRA Routing + Pre/Post Token Bucket)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 0.9ms C++ proxy overhead, 120ms failover, native K8s vLLM KV/LoRA routing & -64.2% TCO
